---
title: "Chapter 12: Hollingsworth et al. (2022) — Marijuana Legalization and Opioid Mortality"
---

**Research Question:** How does marijuana legalization (medical and recreational) affect opioid mortality?

**Data:** State-year panel 1999–2018. Two binary treatments: `med_cannabis` (medical legalization) and `rec_cannabis` (recreational legalization). Outcome: `logmortality` (log opioid mortality rate per 100k).

---

## T13: Medical Marijuana — Event-Study Effects

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Stata

```stata
* ssc install did_multiplegt_dyn, replace
copy "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/main/did_applied_book/data/hollingsworth_et_al_2022.dta" "hollingsworth_et_al_2022.dta", replace
use "hollingsworth_et_al_2022.dta", clear

did_multiplegt_dyn logmortality stfips year med_cannabis, ///
    effects(5) placebo(5) cluster(stfips)
```

### R

```r
# install.packages(c("DIDmultiplegtDYN", "polars"))
library(DIDmultiplegtDYN)
library(polars)

load(url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/main/did_applied_book/data/hollingsworth_et_al_2022.RData"))

res_t13 <- did_multiplegt_dyn(
  df        = df,
  outcome   = "logmortality",
  group     = "stfips",
  time      = "year",
  treatment = "med_cannabis",
  effects   = 5,
  placebo   = 5,
  cluster   = "stfips"
)
print(res_t13)
res_t13$plot
```

**Interpretation:** Medical marijuana legalization has positive but insignificant effects on opioid mortality (Av_tot_eff = 0.031, p = 0.155). Pre-trends are jointly insignificant (p = 0.71), supporting parallel trends.

```python
# pip install did-multiplegt-dyn pandas pyarrow
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_dyn import did_multiplegt_dyn

df = pd.read_parquet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/main/did_applied_book/data/hollingsworth_et_al_2022.parquet")

res_t14 = did_multiplegt_dyn(
    df        = df,
    outcome   = "logmortality",
    group     = "stfips",
    time      = "year",
    treatment = "rec_cannabis",
    effects   = 5,
    placebo   = 5,
    cluster   = "stfips",
    trends_nonparam = ["stfips"]
)
print(res_t14)
res_t14.plot
```

**Interpretation:** Recreational marijuana legalization increases opioid mortality by ~8.8% on average (Av_tot_eff = 0.088, p = 0.066), with effects growing over time. Pre-trends are flat and jointly insignificant (p = 0.93).
